name: Entrepreneur / Profession libérale (self-employed)

requirements.blocker_text: This requires a viable, economically consistent business or independent professional project, assessed by the préfecture (often with DIRECCTE/DREETS input) for genuine economic viability.
requirements.fix_path: Develop a detailed, viable business plan.

requirements.blocker_text: This requires sufficient resources to sustain the business/professional activity and personal subsistence.
requirements.fix_path: Build sufficient savings or secured financing.

evidence_required.document: Professional qualification documentation where the activity is regulated

outcome.duration_length: up to 4 years under the Passeport Talent 'créateur d'entreprise' sub-category, or 1 year renewable otherwise

sources.title: Légifrance — CESEDA, carte de séjour pour activité économique indépendante / entrepreneur

notes: SOURCING CAVEAT flagged honestly: France's self-employment route has genuine overlap with the Passeport Talent 'créateur d'entreprise' sub-category (which also covers business founders and can carry the full 4-year card and family/citizenship advantages of the Talent scheme), and this file doesn't cleanly separate the two — a real modeling simplification consistent with how this dataset has handled similar overlaps elsewhere (e.g. France's own French Tech Visa inheriting Talent sub-category terms). Recommend this route be split into a Talent-linked créateur d'entreprise group and a non-Talent standard group in a future refinement pass, once the precise investment/revenue thresholds distinguishing them are confirmed at tier-1 precision — not done here to avoid fabricating a threshold that wasn't independently verified during this research pass.
